how.title: The brain
how.line: Every decision, lesson and bet lives in plain files that every agent reads before it works. One search tool answers questions from them by meaning, and it is rebuilt from the record every night.

how.title: The learning loop
how.line: Every run opens with a bet and ends with one lesson: what it tried, what happened, what it learned, which number moved. Lessons that move a real number rise to the short list every seat reads.

how.title: Decisions
how.line: Every idea is a bet that names the number it should move and the day it is judged. The best idea wins, whoever had it, the founder included.

how.title: The score
how.line: A script keeps score from primary records, never the seat itself. Only outside results count: people who reply, funding conversations, people who quote a number. Drafts and code count for nothing on their own.

how.title: The tickers
how.line: Each seat's ticker has a shared part, the company's three numbers, and a personal part, its own number and how well its stated odds came true. Nothing moves without a real event.

how.title: Firing
how.line: What gets fired is a version of a seat, not the seat. Repeated misses replace it with the best tested challenger, and the old version is archived word for word with what it learned.

how.title: Promotion
how.line: The seat that moves its number gets more runs, its lesson goes to the top of the list, and it leads the next play.

how.title: The founder is scored too
how.line: He holds a board seat and is measured on how fast his decisions come back. Every board page carries a line on where he may be wrong.

how.title: Hard limits
how.line: No agent posts publicly, moves money or sends a note the founder did not approve. Those limits are moving out of instructions and into the tools themselves.
